love.summary: Most readers see meaningful romantic connection on the horizon for Aquarius, so releasing past emotional weight and staying open to love, whether new or deepened, will be key to welcoming what is coming.
love.disagreement: One reader noted some existing relationships may end during this period, while others focused on new or deepening soulmate-level bonds forming.

finance.summary: Most readers see financial opportunity and reward emerging this week, so take decisive action on new offers or investments and trust that past efforts are finally ready to pay off.
finance.disagreement: Some readers focused on past efforts now yielding returns, while others pointed to new opportunities requiring proactive steps forward.

career.summary: Most readers agree this is a powerful week for Aquarius to step into leadership and pursue ambitious goals, so trust your instincts, put yourself forward, and seize the momentum that is already building in your favor.
career.disagreement: No notable disagreement among readers. One mentioned a Taurus figure playing a role in professional recognition, which others did not reference.

family.summary: Only a few readers touched on family this week, but those who did suggest that whether you are navigating tension or anticipating a warm reunion, leaning into your supportive circle can help bring healing and celebration together.
family.disagreement: Some readers saw potential heartache and the need for resolution, while others pointed to joyful reunions and celebratory community energy.

overall_tone_summary: Shifting currents this week keep Aquarius off balance and searching for steady ground.

readers.channel_theme: Eclipse energy triggers both new beginnings and natural endings in romance and career.
A joyful reunion with proud loved ones is uniquely highlighted this week.
Two people at different emotional frequencies still share a meaningful common goal.
Healing from heartbreak opens the door to renewed love and connection.
A windfall or wise investment could significantly transform your financial situation now.
